programs.title: Delfin
programs.desc: Life isn't easy for Delfin, an 11-year-old boy who lives alone with his father in a small town outside of Buenos Aires. Delfin's ambition is to join a children's orchestra in a neighbouring village.

programs.title: Sabrina
programs.desc: Linus and David Larrabee are the two sons of a very wealthy family. Linus is all work - busily running the family corporate empire, he has no time for a wife and family. David is all play - technically he is employed by the family business, but never shows up for work, spends all his time entertaining, and has been married and divorced three times. Meanwhile, Sabrina Fairchild is the young, shy, and awkward daughter of the household chauffeur, who has been infatuated with David all her life, but David hardly notices her - \.

programs.title: Past Lives
programs.desc: Nora and Hae Sung, two deeply connected childhood friends, are wrested apart after Nora's family emigrates from South Korea. Two decades later, they are reunited in New York for one fateful week as they confront notions of destiny, love, and the choices that make a life, in this heartrending modern romance.

programs.title: The Talented Mr Ripley
programs.desc: Tom, a calculating young man, believes it's better to be a fake somebody than a real nobody. Opportunity knocks in the form of a wealthy US shipbuilder who hires Tom to travel to Italy to bring back his playboy son, Dickie. Ripley worms his way into the idyllic lives of Dickie and his girlfriend, plunging into a daring scheme of duplicity, lies and murder.

programs.title: Piece Of My Heart
programs.desc: While the young dancers Irma and Olga try to stand their ground in the demanding ballet world of 1970s Amsterdam, Olga is launched as the big new star of the Royal Ballet.
